dataset.method: Autostrada Wielkopolska's price list (cennik przejazdów) from 2026-09-11 for the A2 Świecko-Nowy Tomyśl-Konin (Autostrada Wielkopolska II and Autostrada Wielkopolska), the price from station to station paid at the plazas: category 2 (two axles with twin wheels, or two axles with trailers) PLN 253 Konin Modła-Świecko, category 3 (three axles, or two axles with twin wheels with trailers) PLN 364, category 4 (more than three axles, or three axles with trailers) PLN 535. A semi-trailer counts as a trailer (Prawo o ruchu drogowym art. 2 pkt 44). The category goes by the motor vehicle's own axles (give truck.motor_axles; without it all the truck's axles count) and whether it tows a trailer. The Poznań ring between Poznań Zachód and Poznań Wschód is free. The e-TOLL doesn't charge this stretch. The stations are placed at the motorway junctions of their names and their toll booths in OpenStreetMap. Videotolling prices (Poznań-Konin) aren't modelled.
